title: Taking four years off her age when she came to New York
summary: Musicians told her to lie about her age in New York, so she gave 1913 although she was born June 23, 1909. Books repeat 1913, and people today do not believe her real age.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Yes I did. You know, it was such a strange thing. Now, when I got ready to come to New York all the musicians and all the singers that I knew from New York, they said, Helen, don't tell them your right age, there ain't anybody tell them their right age in New York. So you just tell them, if you're 20 you tell them you're just anything. And I said, well, my goodness I never heard of nothing like that. Well I didn't know nothing then. So I said, well okay. And then I said - -

Well I was born June 23rd, 1909 but I put it June 23rd, 1913. And everybody that's been writing books and things, they got 1913. But I didn't know what else to do because everybody I know, they put their ages ten years back, at least ten years. Some of them went back fifteen and twenty. I know alot of them. But I didn't. And then when I tell people my age they don't believe me. They think I'm telling a
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
fib. They say, you ain't that old. And I say, so what difference does it make?

It's like you say you'd be listening to somebody on the radio and you know you're a little girl when you're listening to them and then fifteen years later you come to find out they're younger than you are.
